A '''flight harness''' or '''gear harness''' was a safety strap typically worn as part of a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]]. The harness strapped around an individual's [[Limb/Legends|legs]] just below the knees.

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] wore a gear harness as part of their standard-issue [[Rebel flight suit|flight suit]]. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] also wore a gear harness as part of his yellow flight suit.
